media.alt: A 22 second walk through the empty former DMV that will become Fore Motion Golf with owner Justin Myrick: the front lobby by the door, the long room where the four TrackMan bays go, the spot for the putting area, and the counter where the bar and lounge go. Two 3D concept views, each labeled Concept, cut in: a push into a finished simulator bay with a golfer on the tee mat, and a track along the central putting green. Lines on screen: Walk the space, Owner Justin Myrick walks the space, Four TrackMan bays, The bays, as planned, A putting area, The putting green, A bar and lounge. It ends on Join the Founders List, Opening early 2027, 1518 Park Ave, Orange Park, FL, and foremotiongolf.com.

Owner Justin Myrick in a mint polo walks down the long, empty room of the former DMV with his arm out along the old counter, under the Fore Motion Golf logo. A deep green band reads Four TrackMan bays, with foremotiongolf.com at the foot.
